cases.name: etaf-tanks-maps-are-validated-before-play

cases.purpose: Out-of-range settings are rejected and difficulty sets the starting lives.

cases.purpose: A shell reaching the eagle base loses the battle.

cases.purpose: An armored tank loses one armor per hit and is tallied only when destroyed.

cases.purpose: Snapshots restore the battle paused while malformed or missing files preserve it.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-battles-are-independent
cases.purpose: One running instance cannot advance a second paused battlefield.

cases.purpose: The editor paints and saves a custom map that test play and the catalog use.

cases.purpose: Appearance and resizing preserve the battlefield, state and keyboard focus.
